topic_ko: 소유보다 경험, 다양성과 맞춤화, 유연성과 편리함이라는 소비자 가치가 구독 경제를 사랑받게 만든다

passage: How people buy today explains why subscription services keep winning them over.
A growing number of shoppers care more about what they can experience than about what they can own.
A monthly plan suits them perfectly, since it hands over access without demanding ownership.
Streaming music removes the need for shelves of discs, and clothing services remove the need for crowded drawers.
Beyond that, buyers want variety and want it shaped to themselves.
A wide menu of plans lets each person build an experience around personal taste, which younger customers especially enjoy.
Flexibility matters just as much: one price may open a whole range of goods, or a plan may shrink to the few items truly needed.
Online platforms then make the whole process effortless, so a handful of clicks brings the service, the swap, or the upgrade.
choices: the consumer values that make subscription services appealing
the technical process of building a music streaming platform
the reasons young people spend far more money than older adults
the manufacturing steps behind custom-made skincare products
the dangers of signing up for more services than one can afford
theme.explanation_ko: 소유보다 경험, 다양성과 맞춤화, 유연성과 편리함이라는 세 가지 소비자 가치로 구독이 사랑받는 이유를 설명하므로 ①이 주제이다.
theme.distractor_ko: ② 플랫폼 구축 기술은 다루지 않는다. ③ 젊은 세대는 맞춤화를 선호하는 집단으로 언급될 뿐 지출 비교는 없다. ④ 맞춤 화장품은 맞춤화의 한 예시일 뿐 제조 공정을 설명하지 않는다. ⑤ 본문은 장점만 나열하며 위험은 언급하지 않는다.

passage: The popularity of subscriptions is tied to a change in what buyers value.
Owning an object matters less now than living through an experience.
Plans that grant access without ownership therefore feel natural to modern shoppers.
Music arrives without discs, and clothing arrives without a drawer that overflows.
Buyers also expect choice that bends toward their own preferences and interests.
Younger customers in particular enjoy showing who they are through what they choose.
A fixed fee may cover many goods, or a slimmer plan may cover only what is genuinely needed.
Online platforms complete the picture by making every step take only a few clicks.
choices: 구독 경제는 경험·맞춤화·유연함을 중시하는 소비자 가치에 부합하기에 사랑받는다.
젊은 세대는 기성세대보다 훨씬 더 많은 돈을 구독에 쓰고 있다.
구독 서비스가 늘어날수록 소비자의 고정 지출 부담이 커진다.
온라인 플랫폼의 발달로 제품의 생산 원가가 크게 낮아졌다.
맞춤형 화장품 제조 기술이 구독 산업 전체를 이끌고 있다.
gist.explanation_ko: 세 가지 소비자 가치가 구독의 인기를 설명한다는 것이 요지이므로 ①이 적절하다.
gist.distractor_ko: ② 세대 간 지출 비교는 본문에 없다. ③ 본문은 오히려 절약 가능성을 말한다. ④ 생산 원가 절감은 언급되지 않는다. ⑤ 화장품은 여러 예시 중 하나일 뿐이다.

passage: Ask why subscriptions are so well loved and the answer lies in the buyers themselves.
Experience now outranks possession for a growing share of them.
Access without ownership is exactly what a monthly plan delivers.
Endless music needs no disc, and a rotating wardrobe needs no crowded drawer.
Variety is the second draw, and it comes shaped to individual taste.
Cosmetics services even study a customer's skin and build products for that person alone.
Flexibility is the third: pay one fixed price for many goods, or trim the plan to the essentials.
Add online platforms, and a few clicks deliver the service, the change of device, or the newest model.
choices: Access, Personalization, and Flexibility: Why Buyers Love Subscriptions
How to Build a Successful Cosmetics Company from Nothing
The Hidden Price of Owning Too Many Monthly Plans
Young Consumers: The Biggest Spenders of Our Time
Online Platforms and the Fall of Traditional Shops
title.explanation_ko: 접근·맞춤화·유연성이라는 세 이유를 모두 담아 소비자가 구독을 사랑하는 까닭을 밝히므로 ①이 제목으로 적절하다.
title.distractor_ko: ② 화장품 회사 창업법은 다루지 않는다. ③ 숨은 비용·위험은 언급이 없다. ④ 젊은 세대의 지출 규모는 본문에 없다. ⑤ 전통 상점의 몰락은 나오지 않는다.

passage: The subscription economy fits closely with how people consume goods and services nowadays.
More and more shoppers put experiences ahead of possessions.
That preference makes a monthly plan attractive, because it grants access without demanding ownership.
Streaming music, for instance, brings limitless songs with no disc albums to store.
Another example is subscribing to clothing services, where consumers can explore a variety of clothing styles without filling up their drawers.
Buyers also value diversity and customization, and plans can be shaped around personal taste.
Cosmetics services study a customer's skin and recommend products made for that person alone.
Flexibility and online platforms complete the appeal, since a few clicks bring the service or the upgrade.
implication.underlined: Another example is subscribing to clothing services, where consumers can explore a variety of clothing styles without filling up their drawers.
choices: People can try many different outfits without having to own and store them.
People are advised to buy larger drawers before subscribing to clothing services.
People must return every item they borrow on exactly the same day.
People find that clothing subscriptions are cheaper than any single purchase.
People prefer to keep only one style of clothing throughout the year.
implication.explanation_ko: 서랍을 채우지 않고 다양한 스타일을 탐색한다는 것은 소유하고 보관하지 않으면서 여러 옷을 입어 볼 수 있다는 뜻이므로 ①이 적절하다.
implication.distractor_ko: ② 더 큰 서랍을 사라는 뜻이 아니라 서랍이 필요 없다는 뜻이다. ③ 반납 기한은 언급되지 않았다. ④ 가격 비교는 이 문장의 초점이 아니다. ⑤ 한 가지 스타일 유지와는 정반대이다.

passage: Subscriptions now shape how people consume almost everything they use each day.
A growing number of consumers care more about experiences than about owning objects.
This makes the subscription economy attractive to them, because it offers access without the requirement of ownership.
By subscribing to a music streaming service, consumers can enjoy limitless music.
The subscription economy offers a diverse range of options, enabling individuals personalize their experiences.
This aspect is more popular among younger generations, as they enjoy expressing their uniqueness.
In other models, consumers can flexibly adjust fees by choosing only the services they need.
Whoever desires a newer device can switch to it within a few clicks.
choices: ①
②
③
④
⑤
grammar.explanation_ko: enable 은 'enable + 목적어 + to부정사' 형태를 취하므로 individuals personalize 는 individuals to personalize 가 되어야 한다.
grammar.distractor_ko: ① 전치사 to 의 목적어인 간접의문문으로 어순이 옳다. ② 전치사 over 뒤이므로 동명사 owning 이 맞다. ④ enjoy 는 동명사를 목적어로 취한다. ⑤ 복합관계대명사 Whoever 가 절 안에서 주어이며 단수 취급하므로 desires 가 옳다.

Subscriptions attract them because they offer access without the requirement of ownership.
A music service brings limitless songs with no disc albums to keep at home.
Consumers also value diversity and customization in what they buy.

The cosmetics subscription service stands out by analyzing customers' skin and recommending products made for each person.

choices: ①

vocab.explanation_ko: 각자의 피부 상태를 반영한 경험은 획일적인 것이 아니라 개인 맞춤형이므로 uniform 은 personalized 가 되어야 한다.
vocab.distractor_ko: ① 소유라는 '요건' 없이 접근을 준다는 흐름에 맞다. ② 음반 없이 '무제한' 음악을 듣는다는 서술로 자연스럽다. ③ 다양한 선택지로 경험을 '개인화'한다는 의미로 옳다. ⑤ 온라인 플랫폼이 서비스를 '이용하기 쉽게' 만든다는 뜻으로 적절하다.

passage: Consumers today weigh experience more heavily than possession.
Subscriptions answer that preference by offering access instead of ownership.
They also promise variety that bends toward each person's taste and interests.
A cosmetics service, for instance, examines a customer's skin before recommending anything.
It may even manufacture products aimed at that individual's particular concerns.
The buyer is never pushed through the same routine as everyone else.
In other words, what such services sell is ______________________.
That is precisely why younger customers, who enjoy expressing their uniqueness, are drawn to them.
choices: an experience built around the individual rather than a uniform purchase
a lower price than any competing product on the open market
a guarantee that every item can be returned within a single week
a limited edition item that only a few customers can obtain
a permanent ownership right over the goods they receive
blank.explanation_ko: 피부를 분석해 개인에게 맞춘 제품을 제공하고 남들과 같은 절차를 거치지 않는다는 앞 내용을 받으므로, 획일적 구매가 아닌 개인 중심의 경험이라는 ①이 적절하다.
blank.distractor_ko: ② 가격 비교는 본문에 없다. ③ 반품 보장은 언급되지 않는다. ④ 한정판 희소성은 논점이 아니다. ⑤ 구독은 소유가 아니라 접근을 제공하므로 정반대이다.

order.given: The subscription economy is closely tied to how people consume goods and services today. More and more of them prioritize experiences over owning things, and a subscription offers access without the requirement of ownership.

blocks.A: Beyond access, consumers value diversity and customization. A diverse range of options enables individuals to personalize their experiences, which younger generations especially enjoy because it lets them express their uniqueness.
blocks.B: For example, a music streaming service brings limitless music without any need for disc albums, and a clothing service lets consumers explore many styles without filling up their drawers.
blocks.C: Furthermore, consumers appreciate flexibility and convenience. One fixed cost may cover a variety of products, or fees can be adjusted by selecting only what is needed, and online platforms deliver it all with a few clicks.

order.explanation_ko: 소유 없는 접근(주어진 글) → 그 예시인 음악·의류(B) → 두 번째 가치인 다양성·맞춤화(A) → 세 번째 가치인 유연성·편리함(C) 순이 자연스럽다.
order.distractor_ko: (B)의 For example 은 주어진 글의 access 를 바로 예시로 받으므로 맨 앞이어야 하고, (A)의 Beyond access 와 (C)의 Furthermore 는 가치가 추가되는 순서를 지시한다.

choices: ①

insert.explanation_ko: 주어진 문장은 Moreover 로 새 가치인 다양성·맞춤화를 여는 소주제문이므로, 접근권 예시가 끝난 뒤이자 다양한 선택지 설명이 시작되기 직전인 ③이 적절하다.
insert.distractor_ko: ①②는 아직 접근권 이야기가 진행 중이라 화제 전환이 이르다. ④⑤ 뒤에 넣으면 이미 다양성·맞춤화를 설명한 뒤에 그 소주제문이 등장해 순서가 뒤집힌다.

passage: Buyers today place experience above possession, and subscriptions answer that shift.
A plan grants access to services and content without asking anyone to own them.
Music arrives without discs, and clothing arrives without an overflowing drawer.
Variety is the next attraction, and it comes matched to individual taste.
Cosmetics services analyze a customer's skin and build recommendations for that person alone.
Younger customers value this most, since choosing well is a way of showing who they are.
Flexibility follows: one fixed price for many goods, or a trimmed plan for the essentials only.
Online platforms finish the job, turning a few clicks into a service, a swap, or an upgrade.
summary.summary_template: Subscriptions appeal to modern consumers because they provide __(A)__ rather than ownership, along with choices and services that can be __(B)__ to each person's taste and budget.
summary.explanation_ko: 구독은 소유가 아닌 '접근(access)'을 주고 각자의 취향과 예산에 '맞춰진(tailored)' 선택지를 제공하므로 access–tailored 가 적절하다.
summary.distractor_ko: storage(보관)·profit(이윤)은 소비자가 얻는 것이 아니고, standardized(획일화된)·restricted(제한된)는 맞춤화라는 본문의 요지와 정반대이다.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 점점 더 많은 사람이 물건을 소유하는 것보다 경험을 우선시한다.
writing.answer: More and more people prioritize experiences over owning things.
writing.explanation_ko: prioritize A over B 는 'B보다 A를 우선시하다'이며, over 는 전치사이므로 뒤에 동명사 owning 이 온다.

writing.question: 다음 조건에 맞게 우리말을 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 업그레이드를 원하는 사람은 누구든지 최신 모델을 경험할 수 있다.
conditions: the latest models 를 사용할 것
writing.answer: Whoever desires an upgrade can experience the latest models.
writing.explanation_ko: Whoever(= Anyone who)가 선행사를 포함해 명사절 주어를 이끌고, 단수 취급하므로 desires 가 된다.

writing.question: 본문의 내용에 맞게 빈칸에 알맞은 한 단어를 쓰시오.
writing.context: Because subscribers only need the service and not the object itself, a subscription offers access without the requirement of ___________.
writing.explanation_ko: 본문에서 구독이 제공한다고 한 것은 without the requirement of ownership(소유라는 요건 없는 접근)이다.

writing.question: 다음 문장을 우리말로 해석하시오.
writing.en_prompt: To come to the point, consumers receive a personalized experience that prioritizes their individual skin conditions, rather than a uniform purchasing process.
writing.answer: 요점을 말하자면, 소비자들은 획일적인 구매 과정이 아니라 자신의 개별적인 피부 상태를 우선시하는 개인 맞춤형 경험을 받는다.
writing.explanation_ko: that 이하는 a personalized experience 를 꾸미는 주격 관계절이고, rather than 은 'B가 아니라 A'의 대조를 만든다.

writing.question: 본문을 한 문장으로 요약할 때 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 단어를 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오.
writing.summary: Consumers love subscriptions because they gain (A)___________ to services without ownership and can (B)___________ their experiences to suit their own tastes.
writing.explanation_ko: 본문의 offers access to services or content without the requirement of ownership 와 enabling individuals to personalize their experiences 에서 찾을 수 있다.

writing.question: 다음 조건에 맞게 이 글의 주제문을 영어로 쓰시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 이 글의 주제를 한 문장으로 쓰시오.
conditions: consumers 와 subscription 을 반드시 포함할 것
writing.answer: Consumers love the subscription economy for its access, personalization, flexibility, and convenience.
writing.explanation_ko: 접근·맞춤화·유연성·편리함이라는 네 가지 소비자 가치를 한 문장에 담으면 된다.
